podcast.body: This album marked Weezer's successful comeback, becoming their best chart performer ever. "Weezer roared back with the Make Believe album, which turned into their best chart performer ever."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 00's Part 3: The Return of Rock

podcast.body: This was the band's fifth album, released in 2005. It was a very big album for the band, selling around 2 million copies, a notable achievement during the era of music piracy and file sharing. Following its album cycle, rumors circulated that Weezer was breaking up. "Make Believe was a very big album for the band, selling somewhere around 2 million copies."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
